study.question: Does removing16 of112 context factor directions preserve the strongest joint model click AUC while reducing measured prediction cost, and is that result stable to balanced versus output-heavy factor coordinates?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: full112 balanced obtains click AUC0.6674485580556159, whereas raw35/56/70 and energy-restored35 lose quality relative to that model. Rank70 reaches0.6668936333381517; output-heavy112 reaches0.6674170725597752. Earlier embedding/scorer/tower reductions and shared-projection/batched arithmetic include quality-losing and null trajectories. The tested storage-saving regime ends at rank70 because the inherited rank guard requires fewer weights than a single dense192-to112 map. This leaves the regime71..111 untested, although it is smaller than the strongest two-factor model. Hypothesis: the weakest16 fresh-context directions have low marginal utility after the fixed one-pass training recipe, and rank96 can preserve quality with less native factor work. The gauge factorial examines optimization sensitivity; it cannot establish that discarded directions are causally redundant. Last round product folding was slower (28.140s versus26.019s inference); branch fusion preserved click AUC with24.970s inference but only15.031ms versus15.101ms p50. This mixed timing evidence motivates retaining a matched native path here rather than importing a speedup claim.

nearest_work.difference: Pinned primary benchmark implementation lines203..211 uses two trainable linear maps without an intervening activation. That algebraic primitive is inherited here, not new. This study constrains only the existing buy-context map, keeps semantic local branches and joint compression, and tests marginal factor budget and factor coordinates. It does not reproduce HiFormer attention/token interactions.

Original-paper URL/provenance verified; detailed text is unavailable through the granted registry and the fallback benchmark section2.3 was read. No original-paper architectural equivalence or priority claim is made.

The entire standalone native full112 model is inherited. Only constructor validation admits an explicit budgeted_factor regime between the dense-map storage boundary and full factor width; all forward and masking methods remain unchanged.

Earlier rank70 has192659 dense Parameters and loses0.000554925 click AUC relative to full112. Rank96 is a bounded milder cut; it deliberately remains larger than dense and is never relabeled as storage-saving versus dense.

study.proposed_difference: A minimal constructor-only regime named budgeted_factor accepts rank96 (strictly below min192,112 but above the dense-storage crossover). The original rank-storage guard is preserved. Remove the final16 singular directions of the fresh W; do not prune a trained checkpoint. Fully cross factor width112/96 with balanced/output-heavy singular-value allocation in four standalone files. The full controls preserve the previous initialization and executable forward. This is capacity/optimization research and routine adaptation, with no new-architecture or novelty claim.

Also report difference from original entry0.666753547526167 and DIN0.6555440824200336. These are prospective margins, not statistical significance or a claim of seed robustness.

Practical prediction-cost utility gate: after quality passes, require at least1% lower matched whole-validation inference seconds AND at least1% lower p50, with p95 no more than1% worse. One pass is preliminary; promote only after paired authorized validation timing repetitions under the same batch/device with execution order alternated. Count all timing/validation costs. If the host interface cannot supply repeats or paired user-cluster uncertainty, explicitly retain a preliminary conclusion.

At fixed rank both coordinate choices have the same initial real-arithmetic product; they have different factor norms and can train differently. Calculate the factorial AUC interaction (A96_output-A112_output)-(A96_balanced-A112_balanced), plus matched cost differences. Comparable performance across gauges would reduce one alternative, not prove rank redundancy.
falsifiers: Either predeclared AUC inequality fails: reject that candidate for quality preservation even if it beats DIN or the older entry.

No measured practical prediction-cost reduction, or nonrepeatable timing advantage: reject efficiency utility even with fewer parameters/MACs. Lower training time alone is not the requested prediction-cost success.

A reduction works in only one gauge or the rank-by-gauge interaction exceeds0.0001 AUC: do not claim coordinate-robust marginal redundancy; investigate optimization only if remaining budget supports it.
